messages:
claire_finance: Noticed 9 credit memos posted today that don't match Stripe. NetSuite shows credits but Stripe has no corresponding refund/credit. MTD revenue is off by ~2.6k. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/billing/recon/1791
sanjay_eng: I pulled the webhook relay logs: looks like Stripe sent invoice.updated once but our relay retried delivery after a slow DB commit. The relay's ack happened before the downstream reconciler finished processing, so reconciler saw the event twice from kafka and created two credits.
melissa_billing: Which invoices? We need a list to void duplicates and adjust GL. Also, how do we prevent this from happening again?
sanjay_eng: Quick query for duplicates: SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) FROM net_suite_credit_memos WHERE source_event_id = 'evt_9b3y' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1; This produced 9 affected invoice_ids. Root cause: at-least-once Kafka + no processed_event dedupe table + early ack in relay.
webhook-bot: deploy: webhook-relay v2.1.8 promoted at 2026-12-05T11:40Z :rocket:
kevin_support: I'll pause the auto-credit job and notify the 9 customers we're investigating. Create tickets for each and flag for fast credit reversal if accounting approves.
claire_finance: Please pause. We can't have duplicates posting to NetSuite. @melissa_billing can you sign off on manual voids for the 9 memos? We'll need a CSV with memo_id, invoice_id, amount, created_at.
melissa_billing: Yes I can sign off once I review the CSV. Also want an audit column with stripe_event_id and reconciler_run_id.
sanjay_eng: Mitigation steps: 1) pause auto-netSuite-writing (feature flag) 2) add processed_events table with unique constraint on stripe_event_id 3) change relay to ack only after reconciler confirmation OR move ack to reconciler side (safer) 4) backfill processed_events from net_suite_credit_memos where source_event_id is set. I'll open PR for the dedupe table + change to ack flow. ETA hotfix ~2h.
kevin_support: I'll open tickets and add templated customer messages. Also set the priority to P1 for those 9 customers.
claire_finance: Once hotfix is deployed, run a dry-run to show we won't double create. Then we can re-run a safe dedupe/void job for the duplicates. Keep me posted here.
